tiers.name: Easy
items: No runes or arrows carried to be able to do the Barbarian Assault tutorial
Some combat gear
Antipoison (recommended, but not required)
A games necklace (recommended, but not required)

tasks.name: Bring the Antipoisons
tasks.desc: Kill a cave crawler in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Kill a cave crawler in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon. Fairy ring AJR is just west of the entrance to the dungeon.
Players can optionally bring an antipoison potion as a cave crawler can poison a player as the name of the achievement suggests.

tasks.name: Why Won't You Die?
tasks.desc: Kill five rock crabs on the shore near Rellekka or on Waterbirth Island.
tasks.notes: Kill five rock crabs on the shore near Rellekka or on Waterbirth Island.

tasks.name: King Conifer
tasks.desc: Find the highest tree on the Fremennik mainland.
tasks.notes: Find the windswept tree, which is the highest tree in the Fremennik Province mainland. It is located north-east of the Keldagrim entrance, next to the fairy ring with code DKS.

tasks.name: Assaulted Goodies
tasks.desc: View the rewards in the Barbarian Assault tutorial.
tasks.notes:
Talk to Captain Cain and view the rewards in the Barbarian Assault tutorial.
Players may use the games necklace to get there quickly. Players cannot have any runes or arrows or they will not be able to view the tutorial.

tasks.name: Oxymoron Incarnate
tasks.desc: Speak to Otto Godblessed about barbarian training.
tasks.notes:
Speak to Otto Godblessed about Barbarian Training.
Otto can be found in his house, Otto's Grotto, a little north of the Baxtorian Falls and south-west of the Barbarian Outpost.
A games necklace is recommended to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost and then walk south-west to his house.

tasks.name: Why Did the Lobster Blush?
tasks.desc: Collect three seaweed from the shore north-east of Rellekka.
tasks.notes:
Collect three seaweed from the shore north-east of Rellekka.
The same seaweed can be dropped and picked up 3 times.

tasks.name: Hunting the Hunter
tasks.desc: Find the hunting expert on the northern ice plains.
tasks.notes:
Find the hunting expert at the Rellekka Hunter area.
To the east of Olaf Hradson (he is north of the fairy ring DKS), is a path leading northward. Stay on this path to reach a big ice platform with stairs. Go up the stairs, and find the hunting expert in the north-west corner.

tasks.name: Peer Off the Pier
tasks.desc: Catch a fish off one of Rellekka's piers.
tasks.notes:
Catch a fish off one of Rellekka's piers.
Players can complete this achievement by catching raw shrimps, or by using Barbarian Fishing.
Raw lobsters, raw sharks, and raw great white sharks however do not count for this achievement.

tasks.name: A Familiar Feeling
tasks.desc: Use the Summoning obelisk near Rellekka's gate.
tasks.notes: Use the small obelisk near Rellekka's main southern gate. This can be done with full summoning points.

tasks.name: Endangered Species
tasks.desc: Kill an adult black unicorn.
tasks.notes: Kill an adult black unicorn.

reward.intro:
Talk to the council workman, who is located on the bridge between Seers' Village and Rellekka, to claim the rewards for the easy achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 5,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 30 or higher)
Fremennik sea boots 1, which grants the following bonuses:
perks: Ability to remotely contact the Fossegrimen to recharge the enchanted lyre, receiving fewer charges than normal Shark (and bass with ring of charos (a)) give 10 charges, manta rays give 20 charges, and sea turtles give 30 charges
Shark (and bass with ring of charos (a)) give 10 charges, manta rays give 20 charges, and sea turtles give 30 charges
Peer the Seer will act as a bank deposit box
Recharging the lyre in person gives an extra 20 charges per fish Shark (and bass with ring of charos (a)) gives 40 charges, manta rays give 50 charges, and sea turtles give 60 charges
Shark (and bass with ring of charos (a)) gives 40 charges, manta rays give 50 charges, and sea turtles give 60 charges

other: Partially completed The Fremennik Isles
Partially completed Garden of Tranquillity
A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen (fairy ring access)
items: Dramen staff/Lunar staff (unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed)
Pet rock

Yak-hide armour (body and legs)

tasks.name: Fremennik History 101
tasks.desc: Learn the history of the Fremennik and outerlanders from Chieftain Brundt.
tasks.notes:
Learn the history of the Fremennik and the outerlanders from Brundt the Chieftain in the Rellekka Long Hall Bar, north of the main southern gate of Rellekka.
All 3 options must be used.

tasks.name: Cool Story, Bro
tasks.desc: Watch a shouting match between the Fremennik isles' tower guards.
tasks.notes:
Watch a shouting match between the tower guards of Jatizso and Neitiznot. Only starting The Fremennik Isles is required to unlock this achievement.
The towers are where Jatizso and Neitiznot face each other across a strait, one on each side. Take the boat from the northern-most pier in Rellekka. From Jatizso, go west, through the city, to the tower, or east for Neitiznot. Climb the tower, right-click the guard and select "Watch-shouting". This process takes about 40 seconds.

tasks.name: Who's a Good Boy?
tasks.desc: Interact with a pet rock.
tasks.notes:
Interact with a pet rock.
If the pet rock is lost, it can be re-obtained from Askeladden in front of the entrance of the Rellekka Long Hall Bar.

tasks.name: Only Takes a Little Vial
tasks.desc: Make three vials in the furnace building at Rellekka.
tasks.notes: Make 3 vials in the furnace room (the western-most building in Rellekka) which requires 3 pieces of molten glass.

tasks.name: You Know You Want It!
tasks.desc: Go to the Fossegrimen and charm her into accepting a raw bass.
tasks.notes:
Go to the Fossegrimen and charm her into accepting a raw bass. Sacrifice a raw bass while having an uncharged enchanted lyre in the inventory and having the ring of charos (a) equipped, and talk to the Fossegrimen to have the lyre recharged. She is located south-west of Rellekka.
The lyre must not be fully charged (60 charges) for this to work, so be sure to use at least one charge before attempting this achievement.
This must be done at the altar; the remote contact option on the Fremennik sea boots 1 does not count.

tasks.name: Yak Attack
tasks.desc: Wear yak-hide armour and kill an ice troll.
tasks.notes:
Wear yak-hide armour and kill an ice troll.
An ice troll (either male or female) that is across the bridges of either Neitiznot or Jatizso must be killed for it to work. Ice troll runts underground in the Jatizso dungeon mine will not work. Neitiznot's trolls must be killed across the second set of bridges (snowy ground). The yak-hide armour top and legs must be worn. Protect from Ranged or Deflect Ranged is recommended. Additional armour and weapons can be equipped.

tasks.name: Fremmental
tasks.desc: Make cheese in the dairy churn in Rellekka.
tasks.notes:
Make a cheese wheel in the dairy churn in Rellekka with a bucket of milk. The dairy churn can be found inside the house connected to the chicken coop, directly east of the Rellekka Long Hall Bar.
A bucket of milk spawns in a building directly northeast of the dairy churn in Rellekka.

tasks.name: Fairy Mountaineering
tasks.desc: Use a fairy ring to appear on a mountaintop, near the windswept tree.
quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes:
Use the fairy ring network to teleport to fairy ring DKS to appear on a mountaintop, near the windswept tree.
Dramen staff or lunar staff is required, unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

tasks.name: You Really Don't Need Any More Shoes
tasks.desc: Look at Yrsa's options for recolouring your boots in her clothes shop in Rellekka.
tasks.notes:
Look at Yrsa's options for recolouring one's boots in her shoe store in Rellekka.
The boots do not need to be changed to complete this achievement. The player's main-hand, off-hand, and boot slots (including overrides) must be empty when talking to her.

tasks.name: Big Game Hunter
tasks.desc: Successfully hunt a sabre-toothed kyatt.
tasks.notes: Successfully hunt a sabre-toothed kyatt at the Rellekka Hunter area. This requires the use of a teasing stick.

tasks.name: Grand Theft Fish
tasks.desc: Steal a fish from Rellekka's market.
tasks.notes: Steal a fish from the fishing stall at the market in Rellekka.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Yrsa, who is located in her shoe store in Rellekka, to claim the rewards for the medium achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 10,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 40 or higher)
Fremennik sea boots 2, which, in addition to Fremennik sea boots 1's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:
perks: Access to the broken pier shortcut between Miscellania and Etceteria
Ability to teleport using the lyre once a day without using a charge
Approval is gained at an increased rate on Miscellania and Etceteria

tiers.name: Hard
other: 52 Crafting Crafting (61 is needed to complete Lunar Diplomacy)
High combat level recommended for How to Maim Your Dragon
items: Equipment to kill three level 74/92 dagannoths as well as a level 160 mithril dragon

One of the following armour sets. Only the helm, body, and legs are required. The price shown with each set is the total current GE price for the helm, body, and legs:

• Spined armour (46,806)

Arctic pine logs
Runes for the bake pie spell (1 astral rune, 5 fire runes and 4 water runes)
Any uncooked pie
Coins to pay Etceterian woodcutters
A Games necklace
Several Lyre charges or house teleports if your home is in Rellekka

tasks.name: Defeating Deadly Dagannoths
tasks.desc: Kill three dagannoths in the first layer of Waterbirth Island's dungeon.
tasks.notes:
Kill three dagannoths in the first layer of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon.
Talk to Jarvald on the westernmost dock in Rellekka to reach the island. The dagannoths are weak to earth spells.

tasks.name: Dress to Impress
tasks.desc: Wear rockshell, spined or skeletal armour and have the locals use an honorific with your Fremennik name.
tasks.notes:
Wear rock-shell, spined, or skeletal armour and have the locals in Rellekka use an honorific with one's Fremennik name.
The core three components of the full set (helm, body, legs) are needed in order to complete this achievement. The superior version of the armours does not work. Simply talk to a local in Rellekka.
It might be easier and cheaper to buy raw materials needed for the armour sets and then have them made by Skulgrimen for the rock-shell armour, Peer the Seer for the skeletal armour, or Sigli the Huntsman for the spined armour.

tasks.name: The Graceful Barbarian
tasks.desc: Complete the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course.
tasks.notes:
Complete a lap of the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course.
Players can use a games necklace to get there quickly.

tasks.name: Runes on the Moon
tasks.desc: Mine pure essence on Lunar Isle.
tasks.notes: Mine pure essence at the Lunar Isle mine.

tasks.name: Pyre At Will
tasks.desc: Make a barbarian pyre ship from arctic pine.
tasks.notes:
Make a barbarian pyre ship from arctic pine logs.
Requires chewed bones or mangled bones, use pyre area west of whirlpool bridge (guaranteed drop from lost barbarian or confused barbarian found in the Ancient Cavern). If mangled bones are used, a level 106 ferocious barbarian spirit will appear. It is not required to kill the spirit that emerges from the pyre.

tasks.name: Fish Fingers
tasks.desc: Catch a tuna without a harpoon.
tasks.notes:
Catch a tuna without a harpoon.
There are plenty of tuna catching spots on the docks around the Fremennik Province. However it is not required to catch the tuna in Rellekka, players can use any harpoon spot, for example the one in Catherby.

tasks.name: Easy As Pie
tasks.desc: Bake a pie using Magic.
tasks.notes:
Bake an uncooked pie using the Lunar spell Bake Pie which requires the player to be on the Lunar spellbook. The spell can be found in the Skilling tab of the Magic panel and requires 1 astral, 5 fire, and 4 water runes.
Players must have the Cooking level required for the pie that they are trying to bake.

tasks.name: How to Maim Your Dragon
tasks.desc: Kill a mithril dragon.
tasks.notes:
Kill a mithril dragon, which are found in the Ancient Cavern.
High combat levels are strongly recommended. The mithril dragon is weak to earth spells and bane ammunition.
A strategy for low-level players is to tag the dragon and then have a higher-level friend finish it off.

tasks.name: A Periodic Table
tasks.desc: Get mahogany from your Etceterian subjects.
tasks.notes:
Get mahogany logs from one's Etceterian subjects in Managing Miscellania.
Sufficient coins in the royal coffers combined with sufficiently high approval rating for a minimum time duration of one day are required.
37,500 coins for one day with 100% approval should yield 1 mahogany log. Players may also simply change one gatherer to mahogany before they collect their resources for this achievement to be completed.

reward.intro:
If the previous tiers of the area tasks have also been completed: Talk to Advisor Ghrim, who is located in the throne room on the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of Miscellania Castle, to claim the rewards for the hard achievement set:
Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.
items: An antique lamp granting 15,000 experience (in the skill of choice of level 50 or higher)
Fremennik sea boots 3, which, in addition to Fremennik sea boots 2's bonuses, grants the following bonuses:

Ability to teleport to Waterbirth Island or "Rellekka Market" (a second location in Rellekka) with the enchanted lyre
Fremennik citizens will use the Far-strider honorific
Ability to switch to the Lunar spells at the Cadarn grimoire in Prifddinas

tasks.name: Jaws Breaker
tasks.desc: Catch a shark with bare hands on Jatizso.
tasks.notes:
Catch a raw shark with bare hands on Jatizso. Catching a raw great white shark at this location will work. Catching a shark with the Bait and Switch Archaeology relic power will also count.
Fishing boosts will work. The admiral pie may be used to complete this achievement at level 91 Fishing. Strength boosts work as well.

tasks.name: Limber Lumber Jumper
tasks.desc: Complete the high-level section of the Barbarian Agility course while wearing an agile top.
tasks.notes:
Complete a lap of the high-level section of the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course while wearing an agile top.
Agility boosts may be used both to obtain the agile top and finish the achievement.

tasks.name: Astronomical!
tasks.desc: Craft at least 56 astral runes simultaneously, without using pouches or familiars.
other: 40 Runecrafting Runecrafting (b) (if using catalytic anima stones)
tasks.notes:
Craft at least 56 astral runes simultaneously, without using pouches or familiars.
Requires a full backpack (28 pieces) of pure essence. Boosts may be used, but players cannot use pouches or familiars.
Players may also use a powerburst of sorcery to double the rune essence multiplier meaning significantly less than 28 pieces of pure essence are required to complete the achievement. Catalytic anima stones can also be used to complete this achievement with only 40 Runecrafting.

tasks.name: First Stryke
tasks.desc: Kill an ice strykewyrm (you do not need to be assigned these as your slayer target to complete this Task).
tasks.notes:
Kill an ice strykewyrm.
Finishing this achievement does not require a player to be assigned ice strykewyrms as a slayer assignment, but the player must be able to damage them while having at least level 93 Slayer (b) during combat. This means either wearing a fire cape, any variant of the TokHaar-Kal cape or have purchased the ability to kill them which costs 2,000 Slayer points. Boosts such as the wild pie will work for this achievement after 28 November 2022 update that made all strykewyrms attack-able without task. If a player attempts to attack an ice strykewyrm via conventional means, even via a ring of recoil, deflection curses, or poison they will cause no damage.

tasks.name: Leap of Faith
tasks.desc: Jump the chasm in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon to gain quick access to the pyrefiends.
tasks.notes: Jump the chasm in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon to gain quick access to the pyrefiends.

tasks.name: No Smoke Without Pyre
tasks.desc: Make a pyre ship from magic logs.
tasks.notes:
Make a pyre ship from magic logs.
Boosts may be used, but the Firemaking and Crafting level must be level 85 at the same time, so it is advised to boost Firemaking with orange spicy stew and Crafting with crafting potions.
For this achievement mangled bones or chewed bones are required. Chewed bones can take quite a long time to collect, so it is advised to kill a confused barbarian inside the Ancient Cavern, or to loot the barbarian corpse there for mangled bones, though this may take a few tries.

tasks.name: This Hasta Work
tasks.desc: Smith a rune hasta at Otto's anvil.
tasks.notes: Smith a rune hasta at the anvil in Otto's Grotto using magic logs and a rune bar.

tasks.name: Potting With Otto
tasks.desc: Make a Super Ranging Mix within Otto's house.
tasks.notes:
Make a super ranging mix within Otto's Grotto.
It is not required to entirely make the super ranging mix, players just need to add caviar to a 2-dose super ranging potion inside Otto's Grotto to complete this achievement.

tasks.name: Axe'll Grease
tasks.desc: Use Balmung to kill a dagannoth.
tasks.notes:
Use a balmung to kill a dagannoth.
The dagannoth has to be in the Fremennik Province, for example in the Lighthouse dungeon.
Killing a dagannoth guardian or killing the dagannoths in the Chaos Tunnels will not complete the achievement.
